items.title: The first black hole image
items.line: On April 10 the Event Horizon Telescope team showed a glowing ring around the black hole in M87. They put its mass at about 6.5 billion Suns.

items.title: Game of Thrones, season 8
items.line: The final season ran six episodes, April 14 to May 19. The finale had 13.61 million US viewers.

items.title: Avengers: Endgame
items.line: It opened April 26 and made about $2.8 billion in its first run, passing Avatar as the highest-grossing film ever for a while.

items.title: Chernobyl
items.line: HBO's miniseries started May 6, written by Craig Mazin. Lithuania stood in for Pripyat, and it won the Emmy for Outstanding Limited Series.

items.title: Parasite
items.line: Bong Joon Ho's film won the Palme d'Or in May, the first for a South Korean film. In February 2020 it became the first non-English Best Picture winner.

items.title: Disney+ launches
items.line: It went live November 12 in the US, Canada and the Netherlands. Ten million people had signed up by the end of day one.
